items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Austin Young... [INTERVIEWEE] I know you're speaking about that. I see him. He wait for the railroad. I see him every day.

ctx.x: Yeah, sitting right over there. Yeah, big old.

Witten Joe was here one night. Austin Young, a lot of those fellows have gone on now. That's right. The drummer too, remember. What's the matter with me? I can't think of his name. You know, played with Big Eye.
I know you're speaking about that. I see him. He wait for the railroad. I see him every day. I can't call him.
